targets.expression: WITH activity AS (SELECT traceIdHidden, MAX(time) AS time FROM (SELECT traceIdHidden, time FROM X UNION ALL SELECT traceIdHidden, time FROM P UNION ALL SELECT traceIdHidden, time FROM F) AS observed GROUP BY traceIdHidden), success_ranked AS (SELECT traceIdHidden, time, duration, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY traceIdHidden ORDER BY time DESC, duration DESC) AS rank_in_trace FROM P), success AS (SELECT traceIdHidden, time, duration FROM success_ranked WHERE rank_in_trace = 1), failed AS (SELECT traceIdHidden FROM F GROUP BY traceIdHidden), token_usage_rows AS (SELECT traceIdHidden FROM U GROUP BY traceIdHidden), states AS (SELECT activity.traceIdHidden, COALESCE(success.time, activity.time) AS time, success.duration, CASE WHEN failed.traceIdHidden IS NOT NULL THEN 'failed' WHEN success.traceIdHidden IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE 'unclassified' END AS status, CASE WHEN token_usage_rows.traceIdHidden IS NULL THEN 'missing' ELSE 'available' END AS token_status FROM activity LEFT JOIN success ON activity.traceIdHidden = success.traceIdHidden LEFT JOIN failed ON activity.traceIdHidden = failed.traceIdHidden LEFT JOIN token_usage_rows ON activity.traceIdHidden = token_usage_rows.traceIdHidden) , rounds AS (SELECT traceIdHidden, COUNT(*) AS rounds FROM A GROUP BY traceIdHidden) SELECT states.time AS time, AVG(COALESCE(rounds.rounds, 0)) AS `Model rounds / turn` FROM states LEFT JOIN rounds ON states.traceIdHidden = rounds.traceIdHidden WHERE states.status = 'completed' GROUP BY states.time ORDER BY states.time
